limitations: Eligible D/R benchmark for 375 of 435 districts; excluded districts remain in the coverage ledger.
Current editions of historical inputs and final candidate rosters are retrospective proxies; this is not a strict as-of replay.
All fitted labels are from strictly earlier cycles. These are revisited historical development comparisons, not prospective validation.
Shares condition on Democratic and Republican candidate votes; other candidates, turnout and vote counts are not predicted.
No full-chamber, chamber-control, chamber-tipping, or current-election forecast is supplied.
District geometry is not admitted by this result. Map identities must be verified separately.
Simulation diagnostics are conditional on the saved historical bank. Predictive resampling does not remove fitted-bank uncertainty.
Candidate member IDs are local artifact identities, not official FEC identifiers.
The eligible-seat subtotal fails the unchanged Senate subtotal-mean Monte Carlo precision gate; race diagnostics are reported separately.

prediction_diagnostics.inherited_historical_bank_error: Not reduced by forecast resampling; fitted bank diagnostics remain separate

scope.trained_bank_reuse: Exact equality of all prepared training arrays, identities, priors and law

report.verification_scope: selected review/fit/result and direct loaded-plan pins; transitive ancestors not replayed
